recipe.title: Pumpkin Spice Protein Mug Cake
recipe.summary: A fluffy pumpkin spice mug cake with 40g of protein, mixed in one mug and ready in 5 minutes.
recipe.story: One bowl, one mug, and a microwave turn pantry staples into a warm pumpkin spice dessert that fits the 40/400 method without any real baking.
instructions: Whisk the protein powder, pumpkin puree, egg whites, almond milk, pumpkin pie spice, baking powder, maple syrup, and salt directly in a large microwave-safe mug until smooth.
Microwave on high for 70 to 90 seconds, until the center is just set.
Let the mug cake rest for 1 minute before eating; it keeps cooking a little as it cools.
Top with a spoonful of Greek yogurt and an extra dash of cinnamon if desired.
tips: Whisk the pumpkin and egg whites together first so the batter goes smooth without lumps.
Microwaves vary — start at 70 seconds and add time in 10-second bursts if the center still looks wet.
Use pure pumpkin puree, not pumpkin pie filling, to keep the added sugar low.
